The main takeaway from our work is that
the duality between two- and four-dimensional gauge theories is intimately connected to integrability.
the duality between the two theories is not only a statement about the moduli space of vacua but also about the dynamics of the theory, in particular the superpotential and the partition function.
the Nekrasvov-Shatashivili limit of the four-dimensional Nekrasov partition function is a powerful tool to construct dual pairs of two-dimensional and four-dimensional gauge theories.
